data.name: Aimaad
data.gender_notes: Aimaad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is a guide and a leader, a scholar and a wise man. The name Aimaad carries the meaning “guide, leader, scholar” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aimaad usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, leader, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aimaad is a name for those who seek knowledge and wisdom, and who lead others to the path of truth.
data.etymology: Aimaad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “guide, leader, scholar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aimaad total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: أيماد
in_arabic.meaning: أيماد تعني الثبات و الدوام و الاستقرار في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: أيماد هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الثبات و الدوام و الاستقرار. و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محمودة في الإسلام. و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات معاني قريبة من هذا الاسم مثل الثبات و الصبر.

in_urdu.name: عیماد
in_urdu.meaning: عیماد کا مطلب ہے ثبات، دوام، اور استحکام
in_urdu.long_meaning: عیماد ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے ثبات، دوام، اور استحکام۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اچھے اور محمود معنی رکھتا ہے۔ عربی جڑوں سے نکلا ہوا، اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں عام ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ऐमाद
in_hindi.meaning: ऐमाद का अर्थ है स्थिरता, स्थायित्व और दृढ़ता
in_hindi.long_meaning: ऐमाद एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है स्थिरता, स्थायित्व और दृढ़ता। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में अच्छे और प्रशंसनीय अर्थ रखता है। अरबी मूल से निकला हुआ, इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عیماد
in_pashto.meaning: عیماد د استوګنې، دوام او ثبات معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عیماد یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه سرچینه اخلي. دا د استوګنې، دوام او ثبات معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو او کلتور کې ځای لري.

in_english.name: Aimaad
in_english.meaning: Aimaad means stability, permanence, and determination in English
in_english.long_meaning: Aimaad is a masculine given name originating from Arabic roots. It signifies stability, permanence, and determination. In Islamic tradition, this name holds positive connotations. Etymologically derived from Arabic, Aimaad reflects values of resilience and steadfastness. Historically, names with similar meanings are referenced in the Quran, emphasizing patience and stability.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aimaad carries a profound cultural impact as it implies the qualities of a competent leader, a knowledgeable scholar and a wise learned man. Aimaad is often looked up to as a beacon of guidance and a source of inspiration for others. In many Islamic communities, individuals with this name are esteemed for their intellectual abilities, moral character, and their contributions to the betterment of the society. Aimaad could be a revered personality from the Islamic history such as Imam Ali (a.s.), known for his unmatched intellect, unwavering leadership and political acumen.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aimaad holds great significance as it is a reflection of the inner qualities of a person striving for spiritual growth and seeking closeness to Allah (swt). Aimaad embodies the ideals of wisdom, knowledge, and righteousness as taught in the Quran and the Hadiths. It signifies an individual who has understood the truths of the universe and is following the path of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) to attain eternal happiness in Paradise. The name Aimaad is a reminder to constantly seek knowledge and guidance from Allah (swt) and to be a model of good character and righteousness for others.
